name: @activepieces/piece-prompthub
description: Integrate with PromptHub projects, retrieve heads, and run prompts.

list_projects.name: list_projects
list_projects.description: List PromptHub projects for a team. Returns information about each project's head revision and groups.

teamId.description: The ID of the team. Can be found in your browser's URL bar when viewing Team Settings, or use current_team_id from /me endpoint.

group.description: Filter projects from a specific group. Must be URL-encoded if the group name contains spaces.

model.description: Filter projects where the head uses a specific model (e.g., gpt-4, claude-2, etc.).

provider.description: Filter projects where the head uses a specific model provider.

aiMetadata.description: List the prompt projects belonging to a PromptHub team, each with its head revision and group assignments. Use this to discover available projects and their IDs before reading a head or running a prompt; optional group/model/provider filters narrow the results. Read-only and idempotent. Requires the numeric team ID.

get_project_head.name: get_project_head
get_project_head.description: Get the production-ready version of a PromptHub project (typically the last commit on master/main branch). Useful for integrating prompts into your application.

projectId.description: The ID of the project. Can be found in your browser's URL bar when viewing that project.

branch.description: Use the head of a specific branch. Defaults to your project's master/main branch. Must be URL-encoded if the branch name contains spaces or special characters.

fallback.description: When enabled, any placeholders not provided in variables will fall back to your Project/Team defaults. Your variable overrides always take precedence.

variables.description: Key-value pairs to override placeholders in the prompt. Both keys and values will be URL-encoded automatically.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the head (production-ready) revision of a PromptHub project, returning its prompt text, system message, model/provider configuration, and variables. Use this to read a project's current prompt without executing it; an optional branch targets a non-default branch and supplied variables can be interpolated into the returned request. Read-only and idempotent. Requires the numeric project ID.

run_prompt.name: run_prompt
run_prompt.description: Run a PromptHub project with optional variables, branch/hash, and chat payload

projectId.description: The ID of the project to run.

branch.description: The branch name to run from (defaults to main/master).

hash.description: Specific commit hash to run from.

variables.description: Key-value pairs to pass as variables to the prompt.

prompt.description: Override prompt text for the project.

metadata.description: Additional metadata to include with the run.

aiMetadata.description: Execute a PromptHub project against its configured LLM and return the model completion. Use this to actually run a managed prompt rather than just read it; you can pin a specific version via branch or hash, supply variables for interpolation, and pass chat messages or an override prompt for the request. Not idempotent — each call invokes the model and incurs a new generation. Requires the numeric project ID.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

nl.Run a PromptHub project with optional va: Voer een PromptHub project uit met optionele variabelen, branch/hash en chat payload

nl.Filter projects from a specific group. M: Projecten filteren vanuit een specifieke groep. Moet een URL-gecodeerd zijn als de groepsnaam spaties bevat.

nl.When enabled, any placeholders not provi: Wanneer ingeschakeld, vallen alle tijdelijke aanduidingen die niet zijn opgegeven in variabelen terug naar uw Project/Team standaarden. Uw variabele overschrijft krijgt altijd voorrang.
